reasoning: Small, roughly circular spots with gray-tan centers and reddish-brown borders scattered on a green soybean leaf upper surface. This bull's-eye appearance — gray centers with darker reddish-brown ring margins — is the hallmark of Frogeye leaf spot. Septoria brown spot was ruled out (no leaf yellowing, spots too well-defined and sparse). Bacterial diseases ruled out (no angular/water-soaked lesions or yellow halos). Phyllosticta considered but spots are more circular and numerous than typical Phyllosticta.
